name: Ansirem's Key
summary: An ancient troll dagger may weaken the magic empowering the Stone of the Tides. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver found the blade in Stranglethorn, then gave it to his daughter Catelyn, who left home for the pirates of Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Wayward Daughter
sections.body: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver has found that an altar, or focal point, amplifies the Stone of the Tides. To overpower that magic, he needs an ancient troll dagger he uncovered while researching in Stranglethorn. He gave the blade to his daughter Catelyn long ago. Headstrong, she left home for the pirates of Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Fighter Disarmed
sections.body: In Booty Bay, Catelyn no longer wears the dagger at her hip. Once the settlement's sharpest knife fighter, she lost a duel to one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Her victor took the troll blade as a trophy. Now disarmed and humiliated, Catelyn faces bitter mockery from her fellow cutthroats.

faq.q: Why does Archmage Ansirem need the troll dagger?
faq.answer: The mage holding the Stone of the Tides channels its magic through an altar. Ansirem hopes an ancient troll dagger can disrupt that empowerment by overpowering it.
Catelyn is the headstrong daughter of Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver. She left her father to take up life as a pirate in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Where did Ansirem find the dagger originally?
faq.answer: Ansirem found the relic while researching in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, then gave it to his daughter.
Catelyn lives in Booty Bay, the pirate haven at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale.
